full_judgment: ATM Afzal, J: This appeal by leave at the instance of the Pre-emptee-appellants arises out of a proceeding under section 96 of the Slate Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950. and is directed against the judgement and order dated 8 April, 1984 passed by a Single Judge of the High Court Division, Sylhet Bench in Civil Revision No. 55 of 1983 allowing pre-emption upon setting aside the concurrent decision of the courts below to the contrary.
